common_rules.labelling_general: FSS (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020, as amended
common_rules.additives: Appendix A according to product/FCS unless the individual standard prohibits additives or states otherwise

common_rules.microbiology: Appendix B where the individual standard requires it
common_rules.processing_aids: Appendix C / individual standard as applicable

standards.name: General Standards for Milk and Milk Products

rules.text: General dairy definitions, heat-treatment concepts, use of dairy terms, dairy-term restrictions and generic labelling apply across Chapter 2.1 unless a product standard states otherwise.
Dairy analogues require the prescribed constituent-replacement declarations close to the product name.

standards.name: Standard for Milk

additives.rule: No food additives in milk except permitted carry-over for specified standardized milk products and Appendix A additives in sterilised milk as provided in the standard.

product_specific_label: Declare class of milk
Declare heat treatment
Raw milk designation when sold without heat treatment
Low lactose/lactose free naming where applicable

standards.name: Standard for Flavoured Milk
standards.composition_rule: Minimum milk fat and milk solids-not-fat must meet the applicable milk class from which the flavoured milk is prepared.
product_specific_label: Name: Flavoured Milk
Declare class of milk
Declare heat treatment

standards.name: Standard for Evaporated or Concentrated Milk
standards.definition: Evaporated milk is obtained by partial removal of water from milk by heat or another process producing the same composition and characteristics. Fat/protein adjustment is allowed only to meet the standard without altering the whey-protein:casein ratio.
product_specific_label: Use the appropriate product name: Evaporated milk / Evaporated partly skimmed milk / Evaporated skimmed milk / Evaporated high fat milk.
Evaporated partly skimmed milk may be designated Evaporated semi-skimmed milk when milk fat is 4.0–4.5% and minimum milk solids is 24%.
standards.validation_state: core product definition, raw materials, permitted ingredients, principal composition and product-name rules verified from official Chapter 2.1

standards.name: Standard for Sweetened Condensed Milk
standards.definition: Sweetened condensed milk is obtained by partial removal of water from milk with addition of sugar or a combination of sucrose with other sugars, or by another process producing the same composition and characteristics.
permitted_ingredients: sugar; sucrose or sucrose combined with other sugars consistent with GMP
product_specific_label: Use the product name matching the compositional class.
Sweetened condensed partly skimmed milk may be designated Sweetened condensed semi-skimmed milk when milk fat is 4.0–4.5% and minimum milk solids is 28%.
Products not suitable for infant feeding shall not carry instructions for modifying them for infant feeding.
standards.validation_state: core definition, ingredients, principal composition and product-name rules verified from official Chapter 2.1

standards.name: Standard for Khoa
standards.definition: Khoa/Mawa is obtained by partial removal of water from any variant of milk, with or without added milk solids, by heating under controlled conditions.
cross_checks: Extracted fat shall meet the applicable Reichert Meissl, Polenske and Butyro-refractometer requirements prescribed for ghee.
product_specific_label: Name may be Khoa, Mawa, or another region-specific popular name.
standards.validation_state: core composition and prohibition rules verified from official Chapter 2.1

standards.name: Standard for Cream and Malai

composition_rules.parameter: Titratable acidity for products other than fermented/acidified cream

permitted_ingredient_rules: The product shall be free from ingredients foreign to milk except where the standard expressly permits them.
Milk/whey-derived protein ingredients used as stabilizer/thickener function must contain at least 35% milk protein and are limited to 20 g/kg where permitted.
Starter cultures are permitted for fermented cream.
Non-animal rennet or suitable coagulating enzymes and sodium chloride are permitted for fermented/acidified cream as specified.
product_specific_label: Declare the cream type and fat content.
Use Recombined or Reconstituted qualifier where applicable.
Malai is named Malai.
Declare heat treatment.
Fermented-cream labels may refer to the starter culture.
standards.validation_state: core product types, principal composition, permitted-ingredient conditions and labelling rules verified from official Chapter 2.1

standards.name: Standard for Milk Fat Products
standards.definition: Milk fat, ghee, butter oil, anhydrous milk fat and anhydrous butter oil are derived exclusively from milk or milk products by processes resulting in almost total removal of water and milk solids-not-fat.
raw_material_rules: Milk and products obtained from milk.
Raw material shall be free from added flavour, colour or preservative.

composition.variant: Anhydrous Milk Fat / Anhydrous Butter Oil

product_specific_label: Name the product as Milk fat or Butter Oil; Anhydrous Milk fat or Anhydrous Butter Oil; or Ghee, as applicable.
standards.validation_state: principal identity and composition rows verified from official Chapter 2.1; fatty-acid table and analytical sub-rules remain linked to the source for subsequent machine validation

standards.name: Standard for Butter
standards.definition: Butter is a water-in-oil fatty product derived exclusively from milk or milk products. Table butter shall be made from pasteurised cream.
permitted_ingredients: sodium chloride or food-grade salt, only in table butter
starter cultures of harmless lactic-acid and flavour-producing bacteria
cross_checks: If sold without indication of type, table-butter standards apply.
Extracted fat shall meet applicable Reichert Meissl and Butyro-refractometer requirements prescribed for ghee.
product_specific_label: Use Pasteurized Table Butter or White Butter/Cooking Butter as appropriate.
For white/cooking butter, prefix Pasteurised when prepared from pasteurised cream.
standards.validation_state: core definition, ingredients, composition and labelling rules verified from official Chapter 2.1

standards.name: Standard for Milk Powders and Cream Powder
standards.definition: Milk powders and cream powder are milk products obtained by partial removal of water from milk or cream. Fat/protein adjustment is permitted only to meet the standard without altering the whey-protein:casein ratio.

other_limits.condition: Maximum does not apply to sodium present due to permitted sodium-containing additives.

standards.validation_state: core identity, main composition table and sodium note verified from official Chapter 2.1

standards.name: Standard for Whey Powder
standards.definition: Whey powder and acid whey powder are obtained by drying whey or acid whey respectively.
permitted_ingredients: seed lactose in the manufacture of pre-crystallized whey powder
notes: For whey powder, pH >5.1 may alternatively be assessed by titratable acidity <0.35% as lactic acid.
For acid whey powder, pH ≤5.1 corresponds to titratable acidity ≥0.35% as lactic acid.
Composition may be modified for desired end use (e.g. neutralization/demineralization), but not beyond the specified milk-protein and water limits.
standards.validation_state: core definition, raw material, ingredient and complete principal composition table verified from official Chapter 2.1

standards.name: Standard for Fermented Milk Products

rules.text: Whey removal after fermentation is not permitted except for concentrated fermented milk.

standards.definition: Fermented Milk is a milk product obtained by fermentation of milk by suitable microorganisms with lowering of pH, with or without coagulation. Fermented milk may be heat treated after fermentation; the raw material is subject to the heat-treatment provisions of the General Standard for Milk and Milk Products.
permitted_ingredients: starter cultures of harmless microorganisms, including the cultures specified for the named fermented milks

conditional_ingredients.name: Sugar
conditional_ingredients.condition: Only in Flavoured Fermented Milks, Drinks based on Fermented Milks, Yoghurt, Dahi and Shrikhand.

conditional_ingredients.name: Nutritive sweeteners other than sugar
conditional_ingredients.condition: Only in Flavoured Fermented Milks, Drinks based on Fermented Milks, Yoghurt and pre-packaged Dahi.

conditional_ingredients.name: Permitted non-dairy ingredients / natural flavouring foods
conditional_ingredients.condition: Only in Flavoured Fermented Milks, Drinks based on Fermented Milks and Shrikhand; examples in the standard include fruits/vegetables and their products, cereals, coconut products, honey, chocolate, nuts, coffee, spices, condiments and culinary herbs.

conditional_ingredients.name: Milk and milk products
conditional_ingredients.condition: Only in Drinks based on Fermented Milks.

conditional_ingredients.name: Starch
conditional_ingredients.condition: Only in fermented milks heat treated after fermentation, flavoured fermented milks and drinks based on fermented milks; GMP and Appendix A stabilizer/thickener use must be considered.

starter_culture_requirements.condition: Viable, active and abundant up to the date of minimum durability. Does not apply if the product is heat treated after fermentation.
When microorganisms other than the specified starter cultures are added and a content claim is made. Does not apply if the product is heat treated after fermentation.

composition_rules.condition: General fermented-milk minimum unless otherwise specified. For Flavoured Fermented Milks and Drinks based on Fermented Milks, applies to the fermented-milk part unless otherwise specified.
General fermented-milk minimum unless otherwise specified. For Flavoured Fermented Milks and Drinks based on Fermented Milks, applies to the fermented-milk part unless otherwise specified.

composition_rules.requirement: Same minimum percentages as the milk from which the plain Dahi is prepared.
composition_rules.condition: If plain Dahi is sold without an indication of milk class, the standards for Dahi prepared from mixed milk apply.

variants: Partly skimmed Yoghurt and Flavoured Partly Skimmed Dahi
Skimmed Yoghurt and Flavoured Skimmed Dahi

variant_requirements.condition: Protein content is 6.38 multiplied by total nitrogen determined.

named_fermented_milk_cultures.culture: Symbiotic cultures of Streptococcus thermophilus and Lactobacillus delbrueckii subsp. bulgaricus

regulatory_notes: When Yoghurt or Flavoured Dahi is sold without a fat-class indication, it must conform to the Yoghurt / Flavoured Dahi column.
The term flavoured includes sweetened, flavoured and fruit variants.
Whey removal after fermentation is not permitted except for concentrated fermented milk.
standards.validation_state: Definition, permitted/conditional ingredients, starter-culture requirements, general fermented-milk composition, plain-Dahi fat/SNF rule, Yoghurt/Flavoured Dahi composition table, Chakka and Shrikhand core tables structured from official FSSAI Chapter 2.1.

standards.name: Ice Cream, Kulfi, Chocolate Ice Cream, Softy Ice-Cream, Milk Ice, Milk Lolly and Dried Ice Cream Mix
permitted_ingredients: sugar and other nutritive sweeteners including jaggery, dextrose, fructose, liquid glucose, dried liquid glucose, high maltose corn syrup and honey
starch only in amounts functionally necessary under GMP, considering permitted stabilizers/thickeners
bakery products such as cake or cookies

composition.variant: Ice Cream/Kulfi/Chocolate Ice Cream/Softy Ice Cream
Medium Fat Ice Cream/Kulfi/Chocolate Ice Cream/Softy Ice Cream
Low Fat Ice Cream/Kulfi/Chocolate Ice Cream/Softy Ice Cream

standards.dried_mix_rule: After addition of the prescribed amount of water, Dried Ice Cream Mix shall yield a product conforming to the relevant finished-product standard; Appendix A additive limits apply after reconstitution.
product_specific_label: Use Ice Cream, Kulfi, Chocolate Ice Cream, Softy Ice Cream, Milk Ice, Milk Lolly or Dried Ice Cream Mix as applicable.
Declare the fat class/type for ice cream/kulfi/chocolate/softy variants.
Where starch is present, apply the specific starch declaration required by the standard and current labelling framework.
standards.validation_state: core ingredients, principal composition tables and product-specific labelling rules verified from official Chapter 2.1

standards.name: Frozen Desserts or Confections with Added Vegetable Oil/Fat or Vegetable Protein, or both

composition.variant: Medium Fat Frozen Dessert or Frozen Confection
Low Fat Frozen Dessert or Frozen Confection

permitted_ingredients: starch at GMP where functionally necessary
standards.process_rule: Vegetable oils/fats used in the frozen-dessert standard have melting point not more than 37°C.

standards.name: Standard for Chhana and Paneer
product_specific_label: Use Chhana, Paneer, Low Fat Chhana/Paneer or Medium Fat Chhana/Paneer according to composition.
Low-fat and medium-fat variants shall be sold in sealed packages.
Medium-fat packages declare the milk-fat percentage.
standards.definition: Chhana or Paneer is obtained from any variant of milk, with or without added milk solids, by precipitation with permitted acidulants and heating.
other_permitted_ingredients: spices and condiments, for flavoured paneer only
standards.validation_state: definition, permitted ingredients, complete principal composition classes and special labelling verified from official Chapter 2.1

standards.name: Standard for Cheese and Cheese Products
standards.process_rule: Cheese is made from milk subjected to heat treatment at least equivalent to pasteurization.
product_specific_label: Use the appropriate standardized cheese or cheese-product name.
Apply natamycin surface-treatment declaration when applicable.
Apply outer-packing-removal declaration where required for specified coated/wrapped cheeses.
standards.definition: Cheese includes ripened or unripened soft, semi-hard, hard or extra-hard products in which the whey-protein:casein ratio does not exceed that of milk and which are made by coagulation/concentration processes described in the standard.
process_rules: All cheese shall be made from milk subjected to heat treatment at least equivalent to pasteurization.
Processed Cheese is made by grinding, mixing, melting and emulsifying one or more cheeses with heat and emulsifying agents.
Processed Cheese Spread is made by grinding, mixing, melting and emulsifying one or more cheeses with emulsifying agents and heat.
standards.processed_cheese_nondairy_limit: Permitted non-dairy ingredients shall not exceed one sixth of total solids of the final product on dry matter basis for Processed Cheese and Processed Cheese Spread.
standards.validation_state: core cheese definitions, heat-treatment requirement, named-variety index and processed-cheese non-dairy limit verified; named-variety composition tables remain to be machine-structured

product_specific_label: Name: Edible Lactose

product_specific_label: Name: Milk Protein Concentrate

product_specific_label: Name: Whey Protein Concentrate

standards.name: Cow or Buffalo Colostrum and Colostrum Products

additives.colostrum_powder: Milk-powder stabilizers, emulsifiers and antioxidants from Appendix A within applicable limits

standards.name: Standards for Dairy Permeate Powders
standards.processing_aids: Safe and suitable processing aids at GMP; the standard specifically notes pH-adjustment aids used to improve membrane-process efficiency.
product_specific_label: Name uses lactose-rich deproteinized dairy/milk/whey permeate powder as appropriate
